title: Link your unit
lead: Enter the invitation code from your building's office (in the QR code or SMS you received)

success.title: Unit linked
success.body: {count, plural, one {This account now has # new unit} other {This account now has # new units}}
success.lease: Your lease is linked to this account. Read and sign it to move in

notFound.title: Invitation code not found
notFound.body: Check the code, or ask your building's office for a new one

notPending.title: This code can no longer be used
notPending.body: It has been used or has expired. Ask your building's office for a new one

oa.title: Get messages through your landlord’s LINE
oa.lead: {name} has its own LINE Official Account. Link it to get their messages there instead

gains.label: What comes to this account
gains.news: Announcements and messages about your lease

oa.note: Until you link it, messages keep coming through getproperty’s LINE, so nothing is missed

done.title: Account linked
done.body: From now on, bills and messages come from {name}

used.title: This link has been used
used.body: If {name} has not written to you yet, send anything in its chat to get a new link

expired.title: This link has expired
expired.body: Send anything in {name}’s chat to get a new link

taken.title: This LINE account is linked to someone else
taken.body: The LINE account that follows {name} is linked to another resident. Contact your landlord to fix it

invalid.title: This link can’t be used
invalid.body: Open the link from your landlord’s LINE chat again, or send anything there to get a new one

prospect.title: Get messages through the agent’s LINE
prospect.lead: {name} has its own LINE Official Account. Link it to get its messages about your enquiries there

gains.replies: Replies to your questions about a place
gains.viewings: Confirmations and changes of your viewings

done.body: From now on, messages about your enquiries come from {name}

taken.body: The LINE account that follows {name} is linked to someone else. Ask {name} to fix it

unitInvite.title: Add a unit to your account
unitInvite.lead: The building's office invited you to this unit as a co-owner. Check the details before you confirm.

preview.name: Name on the register
preview.why: A 6-digit code goes by SMS to the phone the office recorded on the co-owner register. If that number is not yours, contact the building's office.

wrongCode.title: That code is not right
wrongCode.body: Check the SMS and try again.
wrongCode.attempts: {count, plural, one {Check the SMS and try again. # try left.} other {Check the SMS and try again. # tries left.}}

codeExpired.title: The code has expired
codeExpired.body: Send a new code and enter that one instead.

tooManyAttempts.title: Too many wrong tries
tooManyAttempts.body: This code can't be used any more. Send a new code.

rateLimited.title: Too many codes asked for
rateLimited.body: Wait a little, then try again.

problem.other: That didn't work. Please try again.

done.title: Unit {unit} is on your account
done.body: {building} is now on your account. Switch between your units from the top bar.

notFound.title: We can't find this invitation
notFound.body: The link may be incomplete. Open it again from the QR code or SMS, or ask the building's office for a new invitation.

notPending.title: This invitation can no longer be used
notPending.body: It was used, cancelled or has expired. Ask the building's office for a new one.

partyMismatch.title: This owner is linked to another LINE account
partyMismatch.body: The name on the register is already used by a different LINE account. If that's a mistake, contact the building's office.

phoneMissing.title: No mobile number on the register
phoneMissing.body: The building's office needs to record your mobile number on the co-owner register before a code can be sent.
